answer: Require every agent to accumulate a verifiable history of useful, attested work before it can transact at scale: trust is earned, not claimed at signup. A new identity arrives with no relic of past attestations, like a comet flashing once and vanishing — cheap to create, worth nothing. Only sustained, checkable contributions, composed line by line like a sonnet, unlock higher limits, so spinning up a thousand sybils costs far more than it can ever earn.
